title: RBA Just Cut Rates — What It Actually Means For You
summary: The RBA has cut the cash rate to 3.85%. But how much of that cut actually reaches your mortgage? We break down the numbers — what banks pass on, what they keep, and what it means for your repayments.

title: Fixed vs Variable in a Falling Rate Environment
summary: With rates trending down, should you lock in a fixed rate or ride the variable wave? We compare the data on both strategies so you can make an informed decision.

title: The Real Cost of Loyalty: Staying With Your Bank
summary: Existing customers pay an average 0.5% more than new borrowers at the same bank. On a $600K loan, that's over $3,000 a year. Here's the data behind the 'loyalty tax'.
